title: On 59th anniversary, The Medical City ranks 1st in oncology, cardiology among PH hospitals
summary: The Medical City (TMC) was named number 1 among Philippine hospitals in cardiology and oncology, and was the only Philippine hospital in the World's Best Smart Hospitals 2027 ranking.
